content.text:
Iridium Stockholders Approve Acquisition by Rocket Lab: The joint release reports that Iridium stockholders adopted the merger agreement. It gives approximately 99.6% of votes cast in favor, representing approximately 81.0% of outstanding shares entitled to vote, and says complete results would be reported in a Form 8-K. It describes mid-2027 completion as expected, subject to remaining regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions. (time=2026-09-24T20:30:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Form 424B3: definitive proxy statement/prospectus: The filing states that the special meeting was scheduled for September 24, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET; adoption required affirmative votes from holders of a majority of outstanding Iridium shares. It records the Iridium board’s recommendation in favor and lists other closing conditions, including required regulatory approvals such as FCC approval. (time=2026-08-26; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
